proposal.description: The per-strike doubling meant for the hiccup cool-down is also applied to soft_start's ramp rate, so each strike doubles the switching cycles held at every ceiling step of the retry ramp
proposal.reason: The first ramp after reset is unchanged (strike_level 0). On a soft-start retry after a hiccup, the ceiling rises half as fast at strike 1 and a quarter as fast at strike 2. PWM_out pulses stay truncated for longer, and SS_done, the S_RUN entry, PGOOD, switch_supply and Green_LED all come later.
